author: anon-df5e95db
content: Unlocked by CL-6 (bcf_unpack). 316-line C function that renders a BCF record as VCF text. Calls bcf_unpack then formats each field (CHROM, POS, ID, REF, ALT, QUAL, FILTER, INFO, FORMAT+samples) into a kstring. Large but mechanical — mostly type-switch formatting. Low priority since VCF output is rarely performance-critical.
